subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Company subscriptions across the platform (most recent 100).

actions.enableAutoRenewDescription: Turn auto-renew back on for "{plan}"? The subscription will renew automatically at the end of its current period instead of expiring.
actions.disableAutoRenewDescription: Turn off auto-renew for "{plan}"? The subscription will be allowed to lapse to EXPIRED at the end of its current period instead of renewing.
actions.renewDescription: Generate the next Invoice for "{plan}" now, ahead of the automatic renewal? Uses the price locked in when this subscription started, not today's plan price. Safe to confirm again if already renewed for this period.
actions.renewSuccess: Invoice generated for the next period.
actions.suspendDescription: Suspend this subscription for "{plan}"? A reason is required for the audit trail.
actions.reactivateDescription: Reactivate this subscription for "{plan}"? A reason is required for the audit trail.
actions.cancelDescription: Cancel this subscription for "{plan}"? A reason is required for the audit trail.
actions.expireDescription: Mark this subscription for "{plan}" as expired? A reason is required for the audit trail.
actions.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this action is being taken (3–500 characters)
actions.reasonTooShort: Reason must be at least 3 characters.
actions.reasonTooLong: Reason must be at most 500 characters.

form.createDescription: Start a new subscription for a company on an active plan.
form.noEligiblePrices: No active price is available for this plan in the company's currency.
form.currencyNote: Prices shown in the company's currency ({currency}).
